Daily News Briefing - 2026-04-29
Topics covered: - The high-stakes legal battle between Elon Musk and OpenAI moved into open court yesterday as Musk took the stand in San Francisco - In a major shift for defense technology, Google has reportedly signed a classified deal allowing the United States Department of Defense to use its artificial intelligence models for "any lawful government purpose." According to reports from The Information, this agreement was reached less than twenty-four hours after over six hundred Google employees signed a formal protest against the militarization of their work - Within the hardware and infrastructure space, Amazon has wasted no time capitalizing on its newly expanded partnership with OpenAI - On the geopolitical front, the United Arab Emirates has officially exited the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries, or OPEC - Domestically, the Trump administration has escalated its scrutiny of the media and former federal officials - In a technical development for the creative sector, Anthropic has released new "connectors" that allow its Claude AI to plug directly into industry-standard software like Photoshop, Blender, and Ableton

Daily News Briefing - 2026-04-28
Topics covered: - The long-standing exclusive partnership between OpenAI and Microsoft has officially ended - Simultaneously, jury selection began yesterday in the high-stakes lawsuit brought by Elon Musk against OpenAI and Sam Altman - In a major escalation of the domestic security crisis, thirty-one-year-old Cole Tomas Allen has been officially charged with the attempted assassination of President Trump at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner - Within the tech sector, labor tensions are rising over the militarization of AI - On the geopolitical technology front, China has officially blocked Meta’s two-billion-dollar acquisition of the AI firm Manus - In space and infrastructure, NASA has pushed the Artemis Three lunar landing to late twenty-twenty-seven at the earliest, as SpaceX and Blue Origin struggle to finalize lander development
